title: ranunculus spicatus subsp. cortusifolius
intro: Ranunculus spicatus subsp. cortusifolius, commonly known as Meadow Buttercup, is a perennial plant species native to Europe. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its multiple health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its potential to alleviate digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce swelling, kill bacteria, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents of Ranunculus spicatus subsp. cortusifolius include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
